description: Proof-of-Edge: the signed, hash-chained, Bitcoin-anchored record of every trade the Omega/PumpSniper bots close, paper AND live (each row labelled; paper = simulated, no money). Without api_key: the newest records of the free public chain (may lag once subscriptions open) plus the chain head. With a subscriber api_key: every record as soon as it is chained. Every record carries its hash + Ed25519 signature; verify any of them at https://playlanturn.com/edge/. Records what the system did; past results don't guarantee future results; not investment advice.

api_key.description: optional Proof-of-Edge subscriber key (edge_...) for the live feed

mode.description: live money only, paper only, or all (default)

since.description: only records after this seq (for polling)

name: omega_edge_feed
